title: Boot sequence
prompt: The robot already has a `boot` function that prints "Booting". Add a second function `ready` that prints "Ready", and make `solve` call boot and then ready, so the output is those two lines in that order.
hints: Look at how boot is written; ready is the same shape with a different name and text.
Add `func ready():` with `print("Ready")` under it, anywhere below solve.
In solve, call `boot()` on one line and `ready()` on the next.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
